metadata.note: VM rehearsal of config/laptop-p14s.json's boot chain: encrypted btrfs root on the @ subvolume (partition mountpoint=null) PLUS a second LUKS device holding swap, so hibernation can resume. dracut + sd-boot. Both rd.luks.name tokens are declared explicitly because KernelCmdlineAction only derives one for the partition that mounts root, and its merge is key-based. Public test passphrase 'hibpass' on BOTH devices (systemd's initrd password cache then asks once); autologins root over serial. NOT for real hardware.

#%PAM-1.0
# Managed by dasik. Vendor file (sudo package) + fingerprint on top.
# WARNING: fingerprint auth for sudo is the CVE-2024-37408 vector.
auth       sufficient  pam_fprintd.so
auth       include     system-auth
account    include     system-auth
session    include     system-auth
session    optional    pam_systemd.so class=none

#%PAM-1.0

auth       include      system-auth
account    include      system-auth
password   include      system-auth
